name: Gameto
description: Biotech using iPSC-derived ovarian support cells (Fertilo) to mature eggs outside the body and shorten IVF and egg-freezing hormone protocols.

name: Overture Life
description: IVF-automation biotech: robotic ICSI, automated vitrification (DaVitri) and non-invasive metabolomic embryo selection.

name: Igenomix
description: Reproductive-genetics testing lab (preconception, pre-implantation, prenatal); spun out of IVI, part of Vitrolife. Operates across Latin America.

name: Fenomatch
description: AI facial-matching platform that selects egg and sperm donors resembling recipients; used by IVF clinics worldwide.

name: Pronacera Therapeutics
description: Biotech developing genetic and molecular diagnostic tests for reproductive health, including endometrial, genetic and microbiome analysis.

name: CENTOGENE
description: Genetic-diagnostics and rare-disease precision-medicine company, including reproductive and prenatal genetic testing.

name: Genea Biomedx
description: IVF lab-technology maker (Geri time-lapse incubator, Gavi and DaVitri vitrification, Gems media), born from Sydney IVF.
